text: Dashboard window now fades in instead of flashing white on launch

Disconnect and power-off now require a press-and-hold: 6 seconds for Disconnect (dashboard and Radio-only gear), 3 seconds to turn a radio off. Turning on stays a single click. A filling ring shows progress; early release cancels
New setting: "When I close the window" — Quit completely (default) or Minimize to tray. Tray menu gains Open dashboard, Radio-only, Toggle mic mute and Quit
Tuning a frequency now plays a Signal Lock animation — digits scramble and resolve left-to-right while a bar locks in underneath
Full ↔ Radio-only switching now cross-fades instead of hard-cutting
Settings → Window opacity slider plus a Hardware acceleration toggle for players seeing ghosted paint
Radio-only HUD is 20% larger so chips, frequency and buttons are easier to read and tap
Returning players skip the opening animation and land straight on the dashboard
Command pre-chirp is now four dings instead of two, so incoming priority traffic is unmistakable
Command chime now plays reliably for listeners even if their audio context had gone idle
Global Chat window no longer flashes or leaves paint artifacts on first open
Default receive volume lowered from 100% to 20% so new operators aren't blasted on first tune
Companion view retired — Full and Radio-only remain. Fixes the voice-continuity bugs that plagued view switches
Pinning the mic chain to 48 kHz removes Chromium's cross-context silencing, so TX survives view switches
Friends' online/offline dots now flip live when they connect or leave — no refresh needed
New operators are assigned a radio rig at account creation so their first transmission carries the full filter
Radio-only redesign — chip strip HUD, two-radio grab handle, pin button, mute strip, cleaner settings
Edit ship name button alongside Edit nodes in My Ships
New update flow — click-to-download card, 10-minute re-checks, and a what's-new list on first launch
Compact mic strip with inline Outgoing / Incoming sliders, PTT rebind, and rig picker in Radio-only and Companion views
Installer and uninstaller now follow your chosen skin so updates feel continuous
Command channel gets a double keyup chime so transmissions stand out from Crew
Companion-view Crew radio no longer goes silent after switching modes (UDP session race)
Receive-volume slider now feels linear across its full range
Tuned frequencies survive switching between Full, Companion and Radio-only
App renamed to Nexus; previous Companion settings and logins carry over
Stay signed in with Discord for about six months instead of a week
Direct messages show presence dots and an unread badge on the Messages button
Deep Blue skin paints cards correctly again (friends drawer no longer appears translucent)
